item.title: Phono Lake Festival - IFM Forest Stage | Intergalactic FM™
item.description: On September 13, the very first Phono Lake Festival lands on Phono Lake’s peninsula, right by the shimmering waters of the Sloterplas — transforming it into a true sonic island.Three stages and on-site afterparties are curated by Intergalactic FM, Field Notes, and Phono Lake themselves — uniting international legends and local heroes, all powered by top-tier sound systems.Intergalactic FM takes charge of the Forest Stage, presenting an out-of-this-galaxy lineup:Alexander Robotnick (live)Detroit
